pipeline.attack_summary: An attacker uses phishing emails containing malicious links to deliver a NetWire RAT variant. The initial payload is a 7z archive that decompresses into an EXE file. The malware employs anti-analysis techniques like dynamic code extraction and anti-debugging, then establishes persistence via registry keys and auto-run entries. It communicates with a C2 server using DNS resolution for IP address discovery, collects system information including credentials, and supports over 80 commands for remote control.

indicators.context: The downloaded file is a 7z file, which contains the new variant of NetWire RAT.
After decompressing it, we are able to get an EXE file with the name of "PROFORMA-INVOICE 0990.exe".
Its domain is found in the decrypted string, which for this variant is "gbam0001.duckdns[.]org:3366".
It checks to see if the current executable file is located in the correct folder (%AppData%\Install) and has the right file name (Host.exe).

It checks to see if the current executable file is located in the correct folder (%AppData%\Install) and has the right file name (Host.exe). If not, it relocates the file into "%AppData%\Install" and renames it as "Host.exe".
NetWire continues to create its home key (HKCU\SOFTWARE\NetWire) as well as adding it into the auto-run group in the victim's registry.
NetWire creates a log folder to store the log files of information that it collects from the victim's system. The log folder is located at "%AppData%\Logs".
It calls the API USER32.GetCursorPos() twice to obtain two mouse cursor positions and then compares them.
It also calls the API ntdll.ZwGetContextThread to obtain the current thread context structure, which contains the CPU debug register status.

id: 5a7b3c9d-1e4f-4a8b-9c2d-1e4f4a8b9c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects initial access to Exchange Server via CVE-2020-0688 exploit using malicious __VIEWSTATE parameter in GET request to /ecp/default.aspx after authentication to /owa/auth.owa.
references:
    - https://www.trustedsec.com/blog/detecting-cve-20200688-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-on-microsoft-exchange-server/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1566
    - attack.t1203
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_method:
        cs-method: GET
    selection_uri:
        cs-uri-stem: /ecp/default.aspx
    selection_viewstate:
        cs-uri-query|contains: __VIEWSTATE=
    selection_magic_bytes:
        cs-uri-query|contains: rO0AB
    condition: all of selection_*/**
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative activity using ECP with valid ViewState parameters
level: high

title: Exchange Server CVE-2020-0688 Execution via Deserialization
id: c131d353-dbc4-43cd-8557-047c4bcaa216
status: experimental
description: Detects execution phase of CVE-2020-0688 exploit by monitoring for malicious commands embedded in __VIEWSTATE parameter during deserialization.
references:
    - https://www.trustedsec.com/blog/detecting-cve-20200688-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-on-microsoft-exchange-server/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1203/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1203
    - attack.t1059
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_method:
        cs-method: GET
    selection_uri:
        cs-uri-stem: /ecp/default.aspx
    selection_viewstate:
        cs-uri-query|contains: __VIEWSTATE=
    selection_payload:
        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - Microsoft.PowerShell.Editor
            - calc.exe
    condition: all of selection_*/**
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative activity using ECP with valid ViewState parameters
level: high

title: Exchange Server CVE-2020-0688 Privilege Escalation via SYSTEM Process
id: 9bffe585-e5e8-460d-bb96-c0f07366596d
status: experimental
description: Detects privilege escalation in CVE-2020-0688 exploit by monitoring for execution of calc.exe as SYSTEM through w3wp.exe process.
references:
    - https://www.trustedsec.com/blog/detecting-cve-20200688-remote-code-execution-vulnerability-on-microsoft-exchange-server/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.t1562
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith: \calc.exe
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith: \w3wp.exe
    condition: all of selection_*/**
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate SYSTEM processes executing calc.exe for troubleshooting
level: high

title: Initial Access via Telnet Enablement in Arcadyan Router
id: 5c8b7e6d-9a1f-4b2c-8d3e-7f4a5b6c7d8e
status: experimental
description: Detects initial access to Arcadyan routers via exploitation of path traversal vulnerability to enable Telnet service using a valid httoken and spoofed Referer header.
references:
    - https://www.tenable.com/security/research/tra-2021-13
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/002/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.privilege-escalation
    - attack.t1078.002
    - attack.t1068
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: null
    service: null
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-stem: /apply_abstract.cgi
        cs-uri-query|contains: ARC_SYS_TelnetdEnable=1
        cs-referer|contains: ping.html
        cs-user-agent|contains: httoken=

title: Veeam Backup & Replication Command Injection via SQL Shell
id: 5f4e8d7a-2c9b-4a1d-9f3e-6b7a8c9d0e1f
status: experimental
description: Detects command injection in Veeam Backup & Replication instance through SQL shell commands that trigger PowerShell execution, leveraging unauthenticated access to TCP port 9401.
references:
    - https://labs.withsecure.com/publications/fin7-target-veeam-servers
    - https://labs.withsecure.com/publications/fin7-target-veeam-servers/jcr:content/root/responsivegrid/responsivegrid/responsivegrid/image_253944286.img.png/1682500394900.png

    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1068/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-26
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.privilege-escalation
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'sqlservr.exe'
            - 'powershell.exe'
            - '-noni -nop -exe bypass -f'

A secondary backdoor (likely CobaltStrike beacon) is deployed via injection into the PlugPlay service.
